title: The Ledger of Manchester's mill district
author: Bram Winterbourne
blurb: Freya Whitlock, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
